title: Intern, Design (2027 Internship Program)
note: Vehicle design studio internship open to industrial, transportation and UX design majors; no housing, relocation or visa sponsorship, and the form asks about living in the local market.

facts.duties: Help check Class A surfaces for feasibility before release to engineering, build 3D models, and manage CAD data for show cars and management review visuals; project scope set with the manager.
facts.requirements: Current bachelor's student in industrial, transportation or automotive design, UX or similar; 18+; able to work on-site full time for the whole program.
facts.apply: Online Greenhouse application with resume (cover letter optional).
